headline: PALADIN BANKS $525M FOR PATTERSON LAKE SOUTH — ASX/TSX Trading Halts Lift Nov 13 as Uranium Spot Nears 6-Month High
snippet: Paladin Energy (ASX/TSX: PDN) raised $525 million to advance its Patterson Lake South uranium project in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin, with trading halts on both the ASX and TSX lifting November 13, 2026. The raise comes as spot uranium trades near $90.55/lb — close to a six-month high — and positions Patterson Lake South as one of the most financially advanced undeveloped uranium projects globally, with a final investment decision process set to accelerate through 2027.

headline: COPPER BOUNCES BACK ON AI DEMAND NARRATIVE — Gold Continues to Slip Below $3,900 as Metals Diverge Nov 13
snippet: Copper prices recovered on November 13 as improved sentiment around AI data-centre demand stabilized base metal bulls, partially reversing the prior week's sharp selloff — copper's worst week since March. Gold, however, failed to participate and continued drifting below $3,900, extending its CPI-driven correction and widening the performance gap between the two metals. The divergence marks a rare split between cyclical (copper) and monetary (gold) drivers in the same session.

headline: NOVAGOLD GOES 100%: $4.2B DONLIN GOLD DEAL CLOSES DEC 1 — NYSE Listing as 'NovaGold Corporation' Begins Dec 2
snippet: NOVAGOLD announced November 10 that its $4.2 billion all-share acquisition of Paulson & Co.'s 40% stake in Donlin Gold LLC is on track to close December 1, 2026, with the combined entity listing on the NYSE as 'NovaGold Corporation' under existing ticker NG starting December 2. The deal consolidates one of the world's largest undeveloped gold deposits — 39 million ounces in Alaska — under single-party control, eliminating the joint-venture management complexity that has historically been cited as a development timeline risk factor.

headline: CRITICAL METALS CORP HITS 2026 GOALS: 100% Tanbreez in Hand, $264.5M Cash, Rare Earth Plant Roadmap for 2027
snippet: Critical Metals Corp (Nasdaq: CRML) announced November 11 it has delivered all 2026 corporate objectives: 100% ownership of the Tanbreez deposit in Greenland — one of the world's largest rare earth resources — alongside $264.5 million in cash and 194.2 million shares outstanding. The company set out its 2027 roadmap focused on advancing a rare earth separation and processing facility, positioning Tanbreez as a potential anchor supplier for Western rare earth supply chains as China's export controls continue to pressure global pricing.

headline: ALTIUS TARGETS FULL TNR GOLD BUYOUT AMID BOARD FIGHT — Mariana Lithium Royalty at Stake in Strategic All-In Bid
snippet: Altius Minerals (TSX: ALS) has made an unsolicited bid to acquire the remaining 87% of TNR Gold it doesn't already own, with exclusivity granted as a special committee evaluates the offer. The strategic logic centres on TNR Gold's royalty on the Mariana lithium salar in Argentina — a long-duration royalty asset positioned for lithium demand recovery in 2027-2028. The deal has been complicated by a board-level dispute at TNR, adding uncertainty to whether the exclusivity arrangement will translate into a binding transaction at the reported ~$122 million implied valuation.

headline: WHY WHEATON AND FRANCO-NEVADA ARE CRUSHING DIRECT GOLD MINERS IN THE NOVEMBER SELLOFF — 5 Streamers to Know
snippet: Motley Fool's November 11 analysis identifies Wheaton Precious Metals (WPM) and Franco-Nevada (FNV) as standout performers during the gold mining correction, with their streaming and royalty models effectively hedging against cost inflation — the dual squeeze of rising oil costs and declining gold prices hitting direct producers. The piece argues streamers offer a structurally superior way to maintain gold exposure in a high-cost, rate-tightening environment and names three additional royalty names with significant upside at current discounted valuations.

headline: IVANHOE ATLANTIC EYES PAKISTAN'S CHAGAI COPPER BELT — MOU WITH MARI ENERGIES TARGETS REKO DIQ NEIGHBORHOOD
snippet: Ivanhoe Atlantic signed an MOU with Pakistan's Mari Energies to pursue large-scale copper exploration in the Chagai district of Balochistan — the same geological belt that hosts the world-class Reko Diq copper-gold deposit. The agreement follows other Western mining groups moving into Pakistan's copper corridor under the country's amended mining code, and builds on government-backed critical minerals partnership agreements. No financial terms were disclosed, but the Chagai belt is considered one of the most prospective untested porphyry copper corridors outside established mining jurisdictions.

headline: USGS: GLOBAL SILVER MINE CAPACITY UP 4% THROUGH 2030 — New Supply Driven by Base Metal By-Product, Not Primary Mines
snippet: A new USGS report projects approximately 4% growth in global silver production capacity from 2025 through 2030, driven primarily by expanded base-metal (copper, lead, zinc) mine output where silver is a by-product — not from primary silver mines. The modest supply growth figure provides context for silver investors at current $51/oz levels: despite near-term macro headwinds, structural supply growth through 2030 is limited, supporting the thesis that any demand recovery or gold-silver ratio normalization could quickly tighten the market.

headline: SMM COPPER MORNING COMMENT: LME FELL 1.37% OVERNIGHT — Rate-Hike Expectations Narrow Nov 13 Trading Range
snippet: Shanghai Metals Market's November 13 morning comment reports that LME copper fell 1.37% overnight as rising US rate-hike expectations continued to pressure the base metals complex, with SMM projecting a narrow, subdued trading range for the session. The overnight decline contrasts with Chinese physical demand remaining tight — Shanghai copper inventories are near three-year lows — highlighting the ongoing split between strong Asian physical demand fundamentals and Western futures-market macro headwinds.
